recognize_zh: 這是非形態學的 G 顯帶核型圖：9 號與 22 號染色體旁有箭頭標示 t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)，22 號位置有多條小型衍生 22 號（費城染色體，der(22) ×3），整體為近三倍體（60<3n>）且伴多條染色體數目異常，38/40 個細胞異常。
features: GTG-banded karyogram at 400-band resolution; 40 metaphases screened and karyotyped
Arrows mark the derivative chromosome 9 and derivative 22 (Philadelphia chromosome) of t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
Three copies of der(22)t(9;22) (three small arrowed chromosomes in the 22 position)
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic G-banded karyotype analysis at 400-band resolution. Thirty-eight of 40 metaphases show a near-triploid clone with 60 chromosomes relative to a triploid baseline, loss of Y and multiple whole-chromosome losses (1, 2, 4, 5, 9, 11, 13, 16, 17, 18, 20), gain of chromosome 15, and a t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with three copies of the derivative 22 (Philadelphia chromosome); two metaphases are normal 46,XY. The multiple Ph copies and complex hyperdiploid/near-triploid karyotype indicate clonal evolution. In the context of acute myeloid leukemia, findings support AML with BCR::ABL1, but BCR::ABL1 fusion should be confirmed by FISH or RT-PCR (including transcript type), and myeloid blast phase of CML must be excluded clinically and morphologically.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in myeloid blast phase
ddx.vs: Blast phase CML shows the same t(9;22), often with extra Ph copies, but has a prior chronic phase, splenomegaly, basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 p210 transcript, which distinguish it from de novo AML with BCR::ABL1.
B-ALL with Ph is separated by immunophenotype (CD19/CD10/cytoplasmic CD79a) and often carries the p190 transcript.

ddx.dx: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: MPAL requires flow cytometric evidence of both myeloid (MPO) and lymphoid lineage-specific markers on the blasts.

ddx.dx: Complex karyotype AML (AML-MR) without true BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: A variant rearrangement mimicking 22q11 loss would lack a BCR::ABL1 fusion signal on FISH or RT-PCR.
